title: A world on edge: January 2025
oneLine: Donald Trump returns to the White House as war grinds on in Ukraine, a ceasefire begins in Gaza, Iran nears the bomb and China presses Taiwan.

whoIsWho.stance: Trump returns promising tariffs and a fast deal to end the war in Ukraine.
Advancing slowly in Donetsk, with North Korean troops helping in Kursk.
Accepts a Gaza ceasefire after 15 months of war; sees Iran as the main threat.
Its allies battered in 2024, it keeps enriching uranium close to weapons grade.
Presses Taiwan with drills and braces for US tariffs.
A new government in Damascus weeks after Assad fled to Moscow.

whyItMatters: Several wars are running at once and the great powers sit on opposite sides of most of them. A new US president who questions old alliances could end some conflicts quickly, or unsettle the countries that rely on American protection.

timeline.text: Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
Hamas attacks Israel; a devastating war in Gaza follows.
Houthi attacks begin to drive shipping away from the Red Sea.
Iran and Israel trade direct strikes for the first time; again in October.
South Korea's president declares martial law and is impeached days later.
Assad's government falls in Syria; he flees to Moscow.
A ceasefire and hostage exchange begin in Gaza.
Donald Trump is sworn in for a second term.
